_doc: Every bed and cue name the sequences use -> its sound (tools/build_mix.py). Paths: gen/ = audio/kit/*.flac (Stable Audio 3.0 Small SFX, generated here, finished by tools/kit_make.py), synth/ = audio/synth (tools/synth_sfx.py: the phone's gloss sounds), vo/ = audio/vo (Gemini TTS: her laugh, his murmur), otm/ = ../one-too-many/audio/sfx (CC0 recordings). Beds: lufs = the bed's loudness against the voices (mix.py sets the voices to -16 LUFS; the bed is kept as built), filter lp:/hp: (several with |), offset = where in the source the bed starts (else a seeded offset), the sequence's level is relative to that name's median. Cues: weight hero|support, align peak|start|end; real sounds get their sequence's room (spaces, rooms), synth/ sounds stay dry (gloss); peak_db = a story beat placed at a designed peak level in the world instead of mix.py's 'just audible' levelling; world = an envelope on the world (dB breakpoints relative to the cue), no sound; voice = a voiced sound placed with the voices, through the treatment 'as'. A list picks by order of occurrence within a sequence; cycle rotates; name@Qnn overrides for one sequence; null = silent on purpose.

phone.what: the app's voice: close, dry, too clean; no room; a little proximity, presence and air; gently compressed; every line the same loudness

door.what: the real woman in the flat: the flat's room clearly around her (RT 0.5 s, 5 dB under the dry voice), a touch of distance (7.5 kHz), her own dynamics

room.what: him in the flat: the same room, a little drier

bed.what: him in bed at night, close: the bedroom's short soft room, barely there

murmur.why: starts in '...apologising to it. Out loud. To the printer.'; the laugh (18.2) lands 0.16 s after 'printer', in the take's longest pause

phone_down.what: CC0 (One Too Many): the phone set on the cushion, a soft cloth touch

footsteps@Q08.what: him, from the couch to the door
her: three slow steps in, then she stops

door_open.why: he opens the door to her: a story beat, levelled in its main band

bag_lift.what: CC0 (One Too Many): ranked above the generated takes

_silent_on_purpose.chewing: no generated take read as chewing (earshot: rubber stretch, spray can); the fork on the pan carries the meal, and its stopping at 30 s carries the stop
_silent_on_purpose.zip: no take read as a zip (earshot forced choice: a spray can hissing 77%); his thumb on the broken zip plays over the room alone: he says nothing
_silent_on_purpose.swallow: a generated gulp did not read as a swallow (earshot: no match, a wet squelch); the line comes out of the quiet instead
_silent_on_purpose.scroll (bed): the seven scroll cues carry his thumb; a scroll bed under them would double it
_silent_on_purpose.app_open: the app makes no sound at all when it opens: nothing dials, nothing rings
_silent_on_purpose.phone_dim: no sound: the room drops out instead (a world envelope)
_silent_on_purpose.breath_held: no sound: the room goes quiet around him (a world envelope)
